title: Does Hatch have voice AI and how good is it?
summary: Hatch has voice AI next to its core SMS AI platform
body_markdown:
Hatch offers a texting and voice AI agent in one platform. They started originally as a texting AI platform and have been offering voice AI recently as well. It seems to be powered by GPT-Live-1.


Many customers we speak to switch to the Leaping AI platform regardless for several reasons.


### Leaping AI Advantage 1: faster speed to go-live


Since their acquisition by Yelp, Hatch has gotten a big-company feel according to many home remodeling companies we speak to. While sales is aggressive, implementation is slow and their customer success team is unresponsive.


On the other hand, we often complete physical onboarding in 48 hours on-site, whilst staying nimble to client demands and customising our product to fit their needs. Furthermore every one of our clients gets their own Forward Deployed Engineer that is reachable every day email / phone and helps with all improvements and CRM integrations.


### Leaping AI Advantage 2: larger variety of use cases


Whilst Hatch touts its voice AI to serve mainly appointment scheduling use cases, Leaping AI voice agents go beyond that: they book appointments, handle customer service issues, confirm appointments and can even conduct recruitment screening calls.


Leaping AI is thus more versatile when it comes to use cases around voice AI.


### Leaping AI Advantage 3: own LLM models


Whilst Hatch uses an off-the-shelf LLM model, Leaping AI has its own open source models selected for home remodeling use cases, running on own GPUs. This leads to better performance and speed of the voice AI agent, since we don't rely on external APIs, but control all the infrastructure in-house.


### Conclusion


Whilst Hatch does offer voice AI, many home remodeling companies choose Leaping AI due to faster speed to go-live, a larger variety of use cases and their integration of custom LLM models hosted on proprietary GPUs, enhancing performance and speed.
